definition: A gene encoding TBC1 domain family member 32, which plays a critical role in ciliary development and function; bi-allelic variants in TBC1D32 cause Alsahan-Harris syndrome (ALHAS; OMIM #621307), a ciliopathy characterized by developmental abnormalities including midline brain and facial anomalies.

source.title: Bi-allelic variants in CDK20 cause a severe ciliopathy with midline brain and facial anomalies
